`APIV1Service.SignIn` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` implements the SignIn RPC business logic. It registers for gRPC-Gateway HTTP at POST `/api/v1/auth/signin`. A thin Connect RPC adapter, `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`, delegates to it.

The Connect adapter is registered at `/memos.api.v1.AuthService/SignIn`.

**`APIV1Service.SignIn`** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`

This is the `AuthServiceServer.SignIn` implementation for RPC `/memos.api.v1.AuthService/SignIn` (defined in `proto/api/v1/auth_service.proto`). It handles password and SSO auth, then calls `doSignIn` for session/token creation.

**Supporting routing (not separate logic):**

- **Connect RPC entry:** `ConnectServiceHandler.SignIn` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` (delegates to `APIV1Service.SignIn`)
- **HTTP/gRPC-Gateway entry:** same `APIV1Service.SignIn`, registered in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` via `RegisterAuthServiceHandlerServer` → `POST /api/v1/auth/signin`
